steps.text: 升级了：三张牌挑一张。同一张以后还会再出，拿几次就叠几层。

texts.en: Level up: pick one of three cards. The same card can show up again later; each pick adds another stack.

steps.text: 都不想要就重选：三张一起换一批，次数有限。

texts.en: Don't like any of them? Reroll swaps all three for a new set. Rerolls are limited.

steps.text: 剔牌：点它再点一张牌，这一局那张不再出，空位补一张。

texts.en: Cull: click it, then click a card. That card won't show again this run, and the slot is refilled.
